fields.label: Cloud Exadata Infrastructure ID
fields.help: The ID of the Exadata Infrastructure to create.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Deletion Protection
fields.help: Whether or not to allow Terraform to destroy the instance.

fields.label: Display Name
fields.help: User friendly name for this resource.

fields.label: Gcp Oracle Zone
fields.help: GCP location where Oracle Exadata is hosted.

fields.label: Location
fields.help: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'.

fields.label: Properties
Compute Count
fields.help: The number of compute servers for the Exadata Infrastructure.

fields.label: Shape
fields.help: The shape of the Exadata Infrastructure.

fields.label: Storage Count
fields.help: The number of Cloud Exadata storage servers for the Exadata Infrastructure.

fields.label: Total Storage Size Gb
fields.help: The total storage allocated to the Exadata Infrastructure resource, in gigabytes (GB).

fields.label: Customer Contacts
Email
fields.help: The email address used by Oracle to send notifications regarding databases and infrastructure.
The list of customer contacts.

fields.label: Maintenance Window
Custom Action Timeout Mins
fields.help: Determines the amount of time the system will wait before the start of each database server patching operation.

fields.label: Days Of Week
fields.help: Days during the week when maintenance should be performed.

fields.label: Is Custom Action Timeout Enabled
fields.help: If true, enables the configuration of a custom action timeout (waiting period) between database server patching operations.

fields.label: Lead Time Week
fields.help: Lead time window allows user to set a lead time to prepare for a down time.

fields.label: Months
fields.help: Months during the year when maintenance should be performed.

fields.label: Patching Mode
fields.help: Cloud CloudExadataInfrastructure node patching method, either "ROLLING" or "NONROLLING".

fields.label: Preference
fields.help: The maintenance window scheduling preference.
Maintenance window as defined by Oracle.
Various properties of Exadata Infrastructure.
